description: This file contains source code for benchmarking various convolutional neural network operations using the Google Benchmark framework. It includes functions for benchmarking quantized 8-bit convolution operations, such as those in models like MobileNet, ShuffleNet, SqueezeNet, ResNet, and VGG. It defines multiple benchmark configurations with different network parameters, initializing and setting up operators, and measuring performance.
